title: platform-objects: the ja-JP and es-ES object bundles ship 383 / 392 leaves as the English source string (Delegated Admin in the Invite dialog role list among them), the class #20462 fixed for zh-CN
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a measured `reach:`**. Finding class **(a)**. `reach:` is the same public door as #20462: the org record page's **Invite user** dialog and every Setup record page read these bundles. Measured by reading the `en`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` object bundles at base `b810ddb6f` (identical at `851af0c27`), not re-driven in a browser.

Filed by the `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01N8TPEsoJxPsdSdNKGnNGEN`, `os-warren`) from the #20462 dev's report (`os-dev-report` 5875946281, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). The at-tier contract review of PR #20490 (record 5876239898, ③.7) re-measured it from the base blobs and recommended filing it. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

Same mechanism as #20462. `os i18n extract --fill=default` seeds each locale leaf with the `en` source, and a present-but-copied leaf reads as translated to every gate. Walk: every string leaf byte-equal to `en` at the same path (1529 leaves per bundle).

| bundle | copies | label | `options.*` | pluralLabel | help | description | placeholder | emptyState |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `ja-JP.objects.generated.ts` | 383 | 210 | 20 | 12 | 121 | 12 | 4 | 4 |
| `es-ES.objects.generated.ts` | 392 | 217 | 22 | 12 | 121 | 12 | 4 | 4 |

- `sys_member.fields.role.options.delegated_admin` and `sys_invitation.fields.role.options.delegated_admin` read `Delegated Admin` in both locales, so the Invite dialog's role list shows it in English.
- The console's own words for that role already exist in objectui: `ja.ts` 委任管理者, `es.ts` Administrador delegado.

## Why it is its own card

PR #20490 (#20462) translates the zh-CN copies only. The card and its triage (5873680175) scoped it to zh-CN, and the order kept `ja-JP` / `es-ES` untouched.

PR #20490 does build the mechanism this card needs: a per-locale echo-decision ledger (`objects-zh-cn-echo-decisions.test.ts`) declaring the leaves that stay English by design, and a provenance companion regenerated by `pnpm i18n:extract`. The zh-CN echo set (brands, bare `ID`, `JWKS`, typed-literal placeholders, `Message-ID`, `UI` / `API`, the result dialog's `Client ID` / `Secret`) is the starting reading for the other two.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

- Translate the user-facing copies in each bundle. Declare that locale's English-by-design set in a ledger of the same shape.
- Use the console's existing words where objectui already renders the same value.
- Record the copy count before and after.
- Triage's #20462 ruling kept the coverage ratchet out of scope. The same would apply here unless the maintainer names it.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` "ja-JP es-ES platform-objects bundle labels copied English source untranslated Delegated Admin" in `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, open and closed: 10 hits.
- #20462 is the zh-CN twin (PR #20490).
- #19897 (closed) is one stale help leaf.
- #16165 (closed) is stale `gap` helpText.
- #17508, #17768, #3370, #14972 and #10026 (closed) are other i18n classes.

None is this.

Dedupe words: `ja-JP objects bundle English copies` · `es-ES platform-objects untranslated labels` · `Delegated Admin ja-JP es-ES` · `i18n copied source string`
